analysis: Independent binary logistic supervision improved host macro validation HR@10 from 0.4437 to 0.4775 (+0.0338), but remained below the reported SASRec baseline of 0.505 by 0.0275. Current category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.530, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.530, Electronics 0.305, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.545. Electronics was unchanged from the sampled-softmax trial and remained below its reported baseline of 0.420. Thus the objective change helped aggregate ranking but did not resolve the Electronics weakness; these results do not establish its cause. The host completed the trial successfully, allocating 944.01 GPU-seconds. No held-out test results were supplied.
code_summary: Trains one independent HistoryModel per category and deploys exactly one best-validation checkpoint per category. The network uses tied input/output item embeddings, positional embeddings, two pre-normalized causal attention blocks with four heads, and contextual pooling combining last state, mean state, and two learned attention pools. An MLP and residual mean produce a normalized context; scores use a learned clamped scale, item dot products, and jointly trained item biases. The controlled change replaces sampled-softmax cross-entropy with softplus(-positive_score) plus mean softplus over valid negative scores, averaged equally across examples. It preserves 64 uniform negative draws, duplicate handling, target/history collision masks, prefix sampling, AdamW, scheduling, and checkpoint selection. Generated prediction code loads the same architecture and verifies score agreement. All four dataset routes, supplied splits, seeds, trial-local artifacts, and single-model inference are retained.
